response.sql: SELECT s.riskeval, AVG(sc.gbsize / sc.spanmin) AS average_gbsize_per_minute FROM scans sc INNER JOIN sites s ON sc.zoneref = s.zoneregistry WHERE sc.chronotag > '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274' AND sc.chronotag < '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797' AND sc.gbsize IS NOT NULL AND sc.spanmin IS NOT NULL AND sc.spanmin != 0 GROUP BY s.riskeval ORDER BY s.riskeval

assumptions.assumption: Scans where spanmin is zero are excluded to avoid division by zero in the average calculation, treating such cases as invalid measurements
